zh: 微不足道的；不起眼的；无足轻重的
en: small and neat in an attractive way
ex: What a dinky little hat!
多么漂亮的小帽子啊！

zh: a British make of small toy vehicle. The original Dinky Toys were made from 1934 until 1979 and included a wide range of model cars and other vehicles. Old Dinky Toys are now collected by adults as a hobby and can cost a lot of money.

该吃饭了。
